changes: Keep heating cycles started before the sunrise saving window eligible for standard learning even when a saving forecast stops them.
Verify learning attribution and prediction feedback across the window boundary and document the change in the public changelog.
Reassess verifiable legacy sunrise exclusions once per curve store using the current window, preserving original evidence and applying standard heating quality checks.
Restore retained heating curves, runtime samples and recorded prediction comparisons without replaying truncated cooling observations.
Migrate stored cooling cycles with a verified target crossing and retained buckets, using an independent migration marker for stores already migrated for heating.
Move historical Peak timeout and sunrise heating/cooling recovery from startup to an administrator-only per-entry Migration button in Learning Analysis.
Report recovery counts and skipped or deferred steps while excluding overlapping learning resets and migrations.
Add a configurable learning-only grace period for heater outages and replay actual observations on same-state recovery.
Exclude unverified cycles when the heater state changes or the grace period expires while retaining the independent heater fault timer.
Recover historical heater outage exclusions from verified heater edges and indoor temperature Recorder history.
Keep heater, peak timeout, and sunrise recovery disjoint with source-reason checks and per-cycle audit evidence.
Cap continuous heater runtime at a configurable 60 to 180 minutes while fewer than ten heating cycles have been accepted.
Record cap-triggered stops and retain the standard coast observation and restart delay.
